none: PAS ESS-10F463: Coin Pendant - Solidus of Valentinian III
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)
DN PLA VALENTINIANVS PF AVG ; VICTORI-A AVGGG ; R/ A AVGGG

A complete gold coin pendant made from a contemporary copy solidus in the name of Valentinian III (425-455), dating to the late fifth century c. AD 450-500. Copy of : VICTORI-A AVGGG reverse type (minted AD 450-455). Mint of Ravenna: R-V//CONOB. RIC X, p.367, No: 2024. Description : The coin has an unusual gold suspension loop with multiple horizontal ribs set within a pair of longitudinal ribs. The loop has been soldered to the edge of the coin above the emperor's head. The coin has a double banded border around its circumference of diagonally opposing pellets and a detached diadem pearl placed within the obverse inscription between the I and A of VALENTINIANVS.
